review: Independent retrospective inspection of retained Phase 2-5 images
method: Each of the 130 listed PNGs was individually opened with view_image, in bounded batches, and visually inspected. No image was approved from geometry alone.
scope: Historical captures. This completes actual inspection of the retained image set, not unshown viewports, expanded disclosures, animation sequences or current final-artifact rendering. Parent owns Phase 7 current-artifact verification.

findings.description: Phase 2 Home and Foundations retain the earlier long, repetitive content and inconsistent presentation; Phase 3 Home and Phase 4-5 Foundations captures show the rebuilt concise sequence.
Phase 2 light Home/Foundation hero emphasis uses bright cyan that is visually weak against the light background; rebuilt headings no longer use that treatment. No numerical ratio inferred.

Phase 2 Training full captures visibly claim Gate pass and Left on disk before a reply/file exists. Independently viewed Phase 6 before/after pairs replace this with expected/pending versus produced/pass semantics.
Phase 4 is an intermediate Foundations state: rebuilt first four lessons coexist with older long platform/harness content. Phase 5 replaces the remainder with concise harness/loop/graph lessons.
Phase 2 mobile Training also contains the one-word heading tail observed in Phase 6. Canonical residual evidence is phase-6-image-verdicts.json.
